assets.name: frame-violet
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high resolution square 1024×1024 PNG mechanical UI FRAME ONLY, true transparent outside and CENTER aperture. Reference image 1 supplies materials. A violet-accent rectangular square mechanical border frame for CSS nine-slice scaling. Symmetrical straight horizontal/vertical continuous edge rails around a large empty fully TRANSPARENT rectangular aperture. The frame occupies the outer 96 pixels (~9%) of each edge, with FOUR precise chunky clipped/chamfered corner pieces contained in 128×128 pixel corner regions. All corner geometry must be entirely within the outer128px. Along the middle of every edge use straight continuous regular metallic rails, easy to stretch/repeat. Detailed machined black gunmetal, brushed scratches, chrome/bronze bevel highlights, restrained accent light strips and tiny bolts. Keep entire frame visible with only minimal transparent outer margin. No lettering, NO icons, NO star background, NO image inside, NO black fill in center, no inset extra panel, NO handset frame. This is one text-free reusable UI border asset, not a screen, not a mockup. Real metallic material; no huge bloom.
